{{Quote|So we need to break into one of the most heavily guarded buildings on one of the Empire's most critical and well-defended worlds and steal the cipher without setting off the self-destruct sequence?|Gnost-Dural outlining the plan|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
The '''mission to Ziost''' took place during the [[Galactic War]] as part of [[Operation End Game]]. In order to sabotage and defeat the ''[[Ascendant Spear]]'', [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] and [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Theron Shan]] stole a [[Black cipher]] from the office of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Minister of Logistics]], [[Davidge]]. Feigning a terrorist assassination, they were able to replace the functioning cipher with a damaged one and escaped back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with the functioning cipher. They were then able to use this cipher to track the ''Ascendant Spear''{{'s}} movements.
